column1: # Shift-fast IDs split; Browser R/D migrate to F2/F8; Recovery Escape modeled as a no-op.
# Former editor Primary+D was a dropped no-op, now unbound; explicit duplicate aliases execute Commands.
# Board Shift+D is the terminal-safe Duplicate fallback; shifted lowercase reports share uppercase actions.
# macOS Board Option+Shift Up/Down and k/j reports are terminal-safe reorder aliases.
# Reflow adds plain Board f and Edit Control+Shift+F, including Control+uppercase-F compatibility.
# Logical Control owns complete-thought and Board boundaries; macOS Control+n follows New for relative insertion while portable Alt remains directional.
# Primary undo/redo is now claimed by every active owner so blocking surfaces absorb it without punching through.
# macOS history adds exact Control+Z, Control+Shift+Z, and Control+Y terminal-safe aliases without redefining Primary.
# Every transient query owner now shares the complete single-line cursor, selection, deletion, and Select All graph.
# macOS submission adds exact Control+Enter and Control+Shift+Enter in the five existing factory contexts.
# Recovery exposes Commands through its configured binding so recovery actions remain discoverable.
# Thought names add exact raw Control+R in Board and Edit on both platform policies.
# Footer visibility adds exact Control+Shift+H in Board, Compose, and Edit on both platform policies.
